decisions.reason: A large bulk container is core to the firm's plastic packaging business, has its own page after only one year, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, the slack of a large firm lets it carry the product while results develop.
The valve complements the bulk container system and has its own page, so it supports the established line and gives no trigger for problemistic search that would justify dropping it.

The take-back service is only mentioned on the website, which suggests lower prominence, but circular-economy regulation and customer expectations in Germany make it strategically useful, and a large firm has the slack to keep it while its uncertain results mature.
